strings.meta.title: pdff — Gatta, fuula oba kyusa PDF, Word, Excel bwa bwereere
strings.meta.description: Akakozesa k'oku mikutu migatta, kakyuusa, kaggyako obuzito, kayawula era kakuuma fayiro zo eza PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne ebifaananyi. Tosaba kwewandiisa, fayiro zigibwakowo mangu ddala.
strings.meta.keywords: gatta pdf, kyusa pdf, pdf eddiza ku word, word eddiza ku pdf, jpg eddiza ku pdf, pdf eddiza ku jpg, ggyako obuzito ku pdf, yawula pdf, excel eddiza ku pdf, ebikozesa bya pdf eby'obwereere
strings.footer.text: Kya bwereere, towandiisa. Fayiro zo zigibwako bw'omala okuzikola.
strings.home.title: Wandikiro zo zonna, mu kakozesa kamu.
strings.home.subtitle: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ebifaananyi: gatta, kyusa era golola mu sikonda ntono.

strings.home.formatsSubtitle: Enkulungo eziyita mu bifo by'emirimu, amasomero n'eby'obusuubuzi.

strings.home.steps[0].text: Sika fayiro zo oba oziggya ku ssimu yo.

strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% ya bwereere
strings.seo.why[0].text: Tewali kusasula kwa buli mwezi, tewali kaadi ya bbanka, tewali kabonero k'obwannannyini ke kyongerako ku biwandiiko byo.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Tosaba kwewandiisa
strings.seo.why[1].text: Tewali akawunti gy'okola: gwa wansi olupapula, sula fayiro zo, kiwedde.
strings.seo.why[2].text: Zikolebwa, ne zigibwakowo mangu ddala. Tetukuumira biwandiiko byo wadde ebikwata ku ggwe.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Enkulungo zonna
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, ebifaananyi, EPUB… okuva ku kompyuta oba ssimu.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Yee. Buli kakozesa ka bwereere, nga tewali kabonero k'obwannannyini wadde ekiguddwa wansi w'okusasula. Tewali kaadi ya bbanka gy'esaba.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Nedda. Tosaba kwewandiisa, tewali email: kozesa ebikozesa mangu ddala.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Nedda. Fayiro zo zikozesebwa ku mulundi gw'osabye gwokka, ne zigibwako. Tewali abisoma era tebisabanyizibwa.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Yee. pdff ekolera mu kirabiro kya ssimu yonna, tabuuti oba kompyuta (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), nga tewali kya kusimba.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, ebifaananyi (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML n'ezirala.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Osobola okukola fayiro ezitwala okutuuka ku {files} wamu, n'ekiwandiiko ekifulumiziddwa kisobola okuba n'empapula ezisukka ku {pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Eby'ekusifu
strings.privacy.description: Engeri pdff gy'ekwataako fayiro zo: tewali kawunti, tewali kiwandiiko ekiyimirizibwa, tewali bikuzibwa n'okutunda ebikwata ku ggwe.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff ezimbiddwa okusobozesa biwandiiko byo okuba ebyo. Gano ge gammwe mu bigambo ebyangu, ebaddwo bw'ozikozesa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Fayiro zo
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ziweerezebwa nga zikuumiddwa (HTTPS), zikolebwa bwazo, ne zigibwako bw'omala okulaba ebifulumiziddwa. Fayiro ennene ziyita mu kifo ky'ekiseera wansi w'erinnya eriganyuddwa ne zigibwako bw'omala okukola; okulongosa kw'obwannannyini kuggyawo buli ekisigaddewo mu ssaawa 24.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Tewali kawunti, tewali bikwata ku ggwe
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff tesaba kwewandiisa, tewali email wadde kaadi ya bbanka. Biwandiiko byo tebisomebwa, tebisengejjobwa, tebisabanyizibwa wadde okukozesebwa okuyigiriza obwengu bw'abantu.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Okupima abagenyi
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Tubala abagenyi awatali kumenya mannya wadde kookisi (Vercel Web Analytics) okumanya ebikozesa ebisinga okugasa. Tewali bikuzibwa, tewali kukuza migendo.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Kookisi
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kookisi emu, ey'okwewakira: ejjukira olulimi lw'olonze.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Okukuumira
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Omukutu gukuumibwa Vercel ku ssaabiiti mu Paris; okukyusa kwa Word, Excel ne PowerPoint kukolebwa Render mu Frankfurt. Bano bakwata fayiro okumala ekiseera ky'okukyusa kwokka.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Tukwatagane
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Olina ekibuuzo oba ekirowoozo? Tuwandiikire okuva ku lupapula lw'omulimu:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Gatta
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Gatta fayiro eziwerako (PDF, Word, ebifaananyi…) mu PDF emu, mu ntegeka gy'olonze.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Gatta fayiro za PDF ku mikutu gy'obwereere (Word, ebifaananyi, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Gatta fayiro za PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne ebifaananyi mu PDF emu, mu ntegeka gy'oyagala. Kya bwereere, towandiisa, tewali kaabonero k'obwannannyini, fayiro zigibwakowo.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Teeka biwandiiko byo byonna mu fayiro emu: pdff eyamba PDFs wansi w'okuwandiika kwa Word, mataala ga Excel, okulaga n'ebifaananyi, n'egigatta mu PDF ennongoofu nga erina akabonero k'olupapula buli fayiro.

strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Enkyusa ey'obwereere: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB n'enkulungo eziwera 40+. Ku mikutu, towandiisa, mutindo gwa waggulu.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Enkyusa emu buli nkulungo: Word okudda mu PDF, PDF okudda mu Word, JPG okudda mu PDF, PDF okudda mu JPG, Excel okudda mu PDF, PowerPoint okudda mu PDF, PNG okudda mu JPG, EPUB okudda mu PDF… Sula fayiro zo era pdff ewaayo enkulungo ezisoboka zokka.

strings.tools.diviser.intro: Weereza ekitundu ky'ekiwandiiko ekinene ekikulu kyokka: pdff eyawula PDF yo okuyita mu mitendera gy'olonze n'eddamya ebintu mu kas n'aka ZIP.

strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Sigaza empapula z'w'wetaga zokka okuva ku PDF, oba ggyawo ezisukka ku ezo. Ku mikutu, bwereere, towandiisa, tewali kaabonero k'obwannannyini.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Lupapula olw'okumpi, ekitundu ekitagasa, ekifaananyi ekirala? Wandiika empapula z'w'osigaza oba z'w'oggyawo (eky'okulabirako 1-3, 7, 10-end) n'ofuna PDF ennungoofu mu sikonda ntono.
